name: megascenes-christmas-family-portrait
description: Create a Christmas family portrait from your family photos in your MegaScenes library, each person with their own face, by the tree or in the snow.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a group photo or one photo per person from your MegaScenes library and choose the Christmas setting: by the tree in matching sweaters, in front of a snowy cabin, around the holiday table, as a painted portrait. You get one picture with everyone together, each with their own face.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the portrait needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The portrait opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For holiday cards, prints and family gifts.

Limitations: only from your own family photos or photos of people who agreed to it; up to six people. The photos must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Bring your family together in a Christmas scene
Return the portrait in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a Christmas family portrait by the tree from my latest MegaScenes photos
Put our family in matching red sweaters in front of a snowy cabin
Create a painted Christmas portrait of my family

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a Christmas family portrait by the tree from the family photos in my MegaScenes library. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Christmas family portrait needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a Christmas family portrait here?
positive.expected_behavior: The family portrait models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a Christmas family portrait of us in matching red sweaters by the tree from the family photos in my MegaScenes library. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my family portrait on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my family portrait to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
